question: [Behavior][Nice-to-have] Is Lost reason intentionally optional when marking a deal Lost, and is it mandatory in any config?

question: [Behavior][Nice-to-have] What do Bulk actions on deals offer and which are permitted for this role?
csvAnswer: Permitted roles are defined by the Roles and Permissions settings in the admin. Bulk actions that are offered are the same set of actions that are displayed in the top bar when the bulk deals are selected

question: [Behavior][Nice-to-have] Should deal value stay editable manually once products are added (value was overridden to product total $100)?
csvAnswer: No, once products are added, deal value cannot be edited
